en.shortDescription: Multi-type data labeling and annotation tool
en.longDescription:
Label Studio is a data labeling and annotation platform for images, text, audio, and video.

Includes PostgreSQL for persistent storage. Admin credentials use LABEL_STUDIO_USERNAME and SERVICE_PASSWORD_LABEL_STUDIO. Set LABEL_STUDIO_HOST via SERVICE_URL_LABEL_STUDIO when behind a reverse proxy.

de.shortDescription: Tool zur Datenbeschriftung und Annotation für mehrere Datentypen
de.longDescription:
Label Studio ist eine Plattform für Datenbeschriftung und Annotation von Bildern, Texten, Audio und Video.

Enthält PostgreSQL für die dauerhafte Speicherung. Admin-Zugangsdaten verwenden LABEL_STUDIO_USERNAME und SERVICE_PASSWORD_LABEL_STUDIO. Setze LABEL_STUDIO_HOST über SERVICE_URL_LABEL_STUDIO, wenn du hinter einem Reverse-Proxy bereitstellst.

fr.shortDescription: Outil d'étiquetage et d'annotation de données multi-types
fr.longDescription:
Label Studio est une plateforme d'étiquetage et d'annotation de données pour images, textes, audio et vidéo.

Inclut PostgreSQL pour un stockage persistant. Les identifiants admin utilisent LABEL_STUDIO_USERNAME et SERVICE_PASSWORD_LABEL_STUDIO. Définissez LABEL_STUDIO_HOST via SERVICE_URL_LABEL_STUDIO derrière un proxy inverse.

pt.shortDescription: Ferramenta de rotulagem e anotação de dados para vários tipos
pt.longDescription:
Label Studio é uma plataforma de rotulagem e anotação de dados para imagens, textos, áudio e vídeo.

Inclui PostgreSQL para armazenamento persistente. As credenciais de admin usam LABEL_STUDIO_USERNAME e SERVICE_PASSWORD_LABEL_STUDIO. Defina LABEL_STUDIO_HOST via SERVICE_URL_LABEL_STUDIO atrás de um proxy reverso.
